data.title: Thailand tries to woo global drugmakers
data.description: The Public Health Ministry is in talks with 10 global pharmaceutical companies to attract investment in Thailand, with MSD emerging as the first major partner, deputy government spokeswoman Lalida Persvivatana said.

data.title: Training boosts logistics careers
data.description: Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat praised public-private cooperation in developing skilled logistics workers after 147 companies hired graduates of a government-supported training programme.

data.title: PM orders airport link reprieve
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered the State Railway of Thailand (SRT) to urgently resolve problems with the Airport Rail Link and ensure uninterrupted service.

data.title: 'Thai Travel Plus' scheme heads towards cabinet vote
data.description: The "Thai Travel Plus" stimulus scheme will be submitted to the cabinet for approval on Sept 22, Tourism and Sports Minister Surasak Pancharoenworakul said, adding that it is expected to generate 20 billion baht in economic activity.

data.title: Korat’s B90-million white elephant
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA - The sad state of a library and observatory, built at a cost of 90 million baht but later closed and left to deteriorate for years, has residents of Nakhon Ratchasima questioning the management of government-funded projects.

data.title: Former abbot, woman remanded in temple embezzlement case
data.description: Police presented the former abbot of Wat Phutthaisawan in Ayutthaya and a woman accused of acting his accomplice to their first remand hearing after investigators alleged that more than 100 million baht in temple donations had been misappropriated.

data.title: Two DSI officials arrested in exam-fraud case
data.description: Duo linked to ‘Mayor Heng’ reportedly handled B55 million in payments from job aspirants

data.title: Korat’s almost B90M in abandoned public facilities raise questions over state spending
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA — Locals of Nakhon Ratchasima have begun questioning the management of state-funded projects after a public library and observatory, built at a cost of nearly 90 million baht, had public access rescinded and were left to deterioriate for over a decade.

data.title: Former abbot, woman remanded over alleged financial misconduct
data.description: Police presented the former abbot of Wat Phutthaisawan in Ayutthaya and a woman accused of acting his accomplice to their first remand hearing after investigators alleged that more than 100 million baht in temple donations had been misappropriated.

data.title: Armed robber takes B1.5m  from Pathum Thani bank, burns getaway car
data.description: PATHUM THANI - An armed robber who made off with 1.5 million baht after robbing a bank in Khlong Luang district on Thursday afternoon later set fire to the car he used in the heist in an apparent attempt to destroy evidence.

data.title: Thai-Malaysian families could be impacted by shortened visa-free stay
data.description: Malaysians married to Thai nationals could be the group affected by the 30-day visa-free programme which will take effect next week.

data.title: 338 MPs back 2027 budget bill, including 58 MPs from opposition Klatham
data.description: Thegovernment secured overwhelming support in the House for the 2027 budget bill, with 338 MPs voting in favour, including 58 MPs from the opposition Klatham Party of Capt Thamanat Prompow.

data.title: Government needs to build public confidence on disaster alerts
data.description: Almost half of people have shown no trust in the disaster warning system in a KPI Poll, which reflected more attempts were needed to boost their confidence.

data.title: Tilapia exports face scrutiny
data.description: A civil society group has called for a traceability investigation into the import and export of blackchin tilapia, citing data showing more than 320,000 fish were exported before the species was reported to have spread in Thailand.

data.title: Thai Airways drug case nears detention deadline
data.description: Prosecutors have ordered the urgent conclusion of an investigation into a transnational drug network linked to a Thai Airways flight attendant, setting Sept 14 as the deadline to prevent three detained suspects from being released.

data.title: First meeting set to hasten conciliation
data.description: Thailand is ready for the first conciliation meeting with Cambodia, scheduled in Singapore from Monday to Wednesday.

data.title: Cloud tech spurs real-life concerns
data.description: Thailand is seeking to capitalise on investment relocating from the United States and China amid geopolitical tensions, but the rapid expansion of data-centre infrastructure has raised concerns over its impact on energy security, electricity and water demand.

data.title: Pheu Thai chief denies Klatham pact
data.description: Pheu Thai Party leader and Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat has dismissed reports of a secret political deal between the Bhumjaithai (BJT) and Klatham parties.

data.title: Klong Toey oil leak downplayed as 'minor issue'
data.description: Deputy Prime Minister and Transport Minister Phiphat Ratchakitprakarn has sought to reassure residents that oil contamination in Bangkok's Klong Toey district was caused by seepage from a pipeline rather than a major leak. He said engineers should be able to seal the affected section.

data.title: Pit bull kills second owner
data.description: A pit bull mauled its 70-year-old owner to death at a rented house in Bangkok on Wednesday, police said.

data.title: King, Queen poised for Vietnam visit
data.description: Their Majesties the King and Queen will visit Vietnam from Sept 14 to 16 to mark the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between the two countries.

data.title: Pheu Thai chief denies Klatham pact
data.description: Pheu Thai Party leader and Labour Minister Julapun Amornvivat has dismissed reports of a secret political deal between the Bhumjaithai (BJT) and Klatham parties.

data.title: PET water bottles 'safe' to drink from, FDA assures
data.description: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has confirmed that PET bottled water is safe to drink despite online claims that bottles stored in cars or left in the sun can cause cancer.

data.title: ARL to keep  operating amid talks
data.description: State Railway of Thailand (SRT) governor Anan Phonimdaeng has assured passengers that the Airport Rail Link will continue operating despite ongoing talks with its concessionaire, Asia Era One Co, a subsidiary of CP Group.

data.title: Govt may extend stimulus
data.description: The government says it will consider extending the Thais Help Thais Plus stimulus programme by the end of this month, noting that if the Middle East energy crisis persists, further measures to ease the cost of living may be needed.

data.title: Thai artists performing in China in celebration of ties
data.description: Around 100 Thai artists and musicians have travelled to perform at the Beijing International Great Wall Concert 2026, taking place Sep 10-11 , marking 51 years of diplomatic relations between the two countries.

data.title: More expert input sought on Bangkok data centres
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) will seek more expert input as it tries to get a clearer picture of the environmental impact and potential effects of data centres on surrounding communities in the capital.
